name: T. K. Long
role: Prosecuting attorney of Morton County, at Mandan
bio: T. K. Long was prosecuting attorney of Morton County, and in April 1885 he came to Medora with Deputy Sheriff Ed Drury to make the town's saloon keepers pay county liquor licenses under a new territorial law, which the Cow Boy questioned; he was back in May instructing them about license bonds. In September 1885 he prosecuted the Marquis de Mores at Bismarck for the killing of Luffsey, publicly attacking Judge Francis and Bismarck itself, and after the Marquis's acquittal he turned Paddock's case over to the judge, who discharged him.
